description: Capability for the main window: core APIs, the native open-file dialog (key file, editor application, Download to… folder), native drag of files out of the window (drag:default = start_drag), the logging plugin, window-state persistence, and the custom-title-bar window controls (Windows). No opener permissions: remote edit opens files from Rust (tauri_plugin_opener::open_path) and the opener plugin is not registered, so the webview cannot open paths or URLs itself.
